verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Zep offers a 'Your VPC' deployment option and mentions Graphiti as an open-source temporal knowledge graph framework that can be run locally, hinting at self-host capability, but there is no explicit Docker install guide, open-source repo, or self-hosting instructions for the core Zep memory-layer product itself (the CLI/install docs reference 'pip install zep-cloud', a hosted SaaS offering). missing for 10: explicit open-source Zep server repo, Docker/compose instructions, and confirmation that the VPC deployment uses open-source code rather than a licensed binary.
